items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Nick Kasbian was a ... [INTERVIEWEE] Trumpet player who was with the first arranger, composer of 'I'm Getting Sentimental Over You' and arr. of 'Let's Dance'.

ctx.x: George Bassman was playing piano just before I joined the band, and he had another new band, but that was the type of musician he had.
Trumpet player who was with the first arranger, composer of 'I'm Getting Sentimental Over You' and arr. of 'Let's Dance'.
